methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date, corroborated with dedicated 2026 pricing-review sources where the official page geolocated outside the USA, rendered prices via a JavaScript seat slider, or returned a 403/429. All prices are per-user (per-seat) per month in USD unless the provider sells flat per-account (Grasshopper, noted billingModel flat); where annual billing is required to reach the quoted rate the monthly list rate and annualDiscountPct are recorded. Quote-only tiers (8x8 entirely, plus Enterprise/contact-sales tiers) are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and the minutes/calls/overage fields are null except where a provider publishes a metered per-minute rate (Zoom Phone Metered).
